title: Abinin özrü

characters.BROTHER: a boy of about thirteen with shaggy black hair, wearing an orange sweater
characters.KID: a boy of about nine with short brown hair, wearing blue overalls
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-five with shaggy black hair, wearing an orange scarf and a brown jacket
characters.YOUNG: a man of about thirty with short brown hair, wearing a blue denim jacket

scenes.text:
Abin sana hiç "Özür dilerim" dedi mi?
Muhtemelen hayır.
scenes.prompt: In an autumn garden, {BROTHER} on the left and {KID} on the right sit at opposite ends of a wooden bench, turned away from each other with crossed arms, golden leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Kavga ettiğiniz akşam,
bisikletini sessizce sana bırakırdı.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, a red bicycle leans against a wooden garden gate, and {BROTHER} walks away from it toward the house, seen from behind, autumn leaves on the path.

scenes.text:
Küstüğünde,
en sevdiğin çikolatayı yastığına koyardı.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy bedroom in warm lamp light, {KID} stands in the doorway smiling in surprise at a chocolate bar lying on his pillow, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Taşındığın gün çağırmadan geldi,
kolilerini tek başına taşıdı.
scenes.prompt: On moving day in autumn, {MAN} carries a big cardboard box up the steps of an apartment building, while {YOUNG} on the right looks at him in happy surprise, golden leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Bazı abiler özrü söylemez, gelir.
Bunu abine gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset in an empty new apartment, {MAN} on the left and {YOUNG} on the right sit on cardboard boxes laughing together, warm golden light from a big window.

caption:
Abin seni sever.

Söylemez belki ama hep gelir. 🤍

Bunu abine gönder.
